raw.rationale: JNJ-26481585 (quisinostat) is a pan-HDAC inhibitor with broad, largely non-lineage-selective antiproliferative activity in PRISM-type screens; strong selective lineage effects are uncommon and mostly limited to hematologic lineages not listed here, so probabilities are near the low base rate with modest increases for lineages showing HDAC-inhibitor sensitivity such as cutaneous T-cell lymphoma-related skin lines and some breast/colorectal contexts.
